{{Quote|The Council of Reconciliation seeks peaceful resolutions to interplanetary disputes. The Senate relies on this council to keep intergalactic peace and harmony. With so many worlds, species, and interests, it's an almost impossible task!|[[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]], in one of his journals|<ref name="Skywalker Journal">''[[Anakin Skywalker: A Jedi's Journal]]''</ref>}}
The '''Council of Reconciliation''', sometimes referred to as the '''Reconciliation Council''', was one of the four [[Jedi Council/Legends|Jedi Councils]] of the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] in operation during the rule of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. The Council of Reconciliation met in the [[Tower of Reconciliation/Legends|southeast tower]] of the [[Jedi Temple/Legends|Jedi Temple]] on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]].

==Overview==
The Council of Reconciliation was made up of five [[Jedi Master/Legends|Master]] [[Jedi Consular|Consulars]] tasked with negotiating with political factions both inside and outside of the [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Galactic Senate]]. Meeting in the circular [[Reconciliation Council Chamber|Council Chamber]] at the [[Jedi Temple/Legends|Jedi Temple]], membership on the Council was granted through appointment after a vote of all members. Two permanent members sat for life or until they stepped down, while the other three rotated out after serving a five year term. Due to the nature of the Council's dealings, variety in membership was needed, so that different Masters could lend their knowledge and expertise to a specific situation.<ref name="TCWCG">''[[The Clone Wars Campaign Guide]]''</ref>

The Council of Reconciliation had a similar relationship with the Galactic Senate as did the Jedi High Council with the [[Office of the Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Office of the Supreme Chancellor]]. Working closely with the [[Republic Diplomatic Corps/Legends|Republic Diplomatic Corps]], the Council sought peaceful solutions to political debates that arose among different parties or different local governments. At the Council's disposal were the Consulars who were trained as (a) [[Jedi Diplomat|diplomats]] or [[Jedi Ambassador|ambassadors]], as well as a slew of [[Jedi Seer|Seers]] that assisted in making key decisions.<ref name="TJP">[[The Jedi Path: A Manual for Students of the Force (real-life book)|''The Jedi Path: A Manual for Students of the Force'']]</ref> Sometimes requested to deal with internal affairs, the Council would pass judgment over Jedi accused of falling to the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side]] of [[The Force/Legends|the Force]], or committing a crime. It was acceptable for other Jedi to appear at the hearing to offer testimony for the accused Jedi. The Council's decision was final, and respected by the other three Councils.<ref name="SWR71" />

Members of the Council often serve on one of the other Councils simultaneously, or have retired from the High Council and retained their membership. The earliest recorded member of the Council was the famed Seer [[Sabla-Mandibu]] who added several chapters to the groundbreaking guidebook, ''[[The Jedi Path: A Manual for Students of the Force]]'', at the request of [[Grand Master/Legends|Grand Master]] [[Fae Coven]] in the years proceeding the passage of the [[Ruusan Reformations/Legends|Ruusan Reformations]].<ref name="TJP" /> High Council Masters [[Oppo Rancisis/Legends|Oppo Rancisis]] and [[Plo Koon/Legends|Plo Koon]] held the two permanent seats around the time of the [[Invasion of Naboo/Legends|Invasion of Naboo]] and throughout the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. When [[Qui-Gon Jinn/Legends|Qui-Gon Jinn]] was called before the Council of Reconciliation after a battle with [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Arwen Cohl]] over [[Dorvalla/Legends|Dorvalla]], the Council of Reconciliation chamber was occupied by Masters [[Yoda/Legends|Yoda]], and [[Adi Gallia/Legends|Adi Gallia]], both serving temporarily. The fifth member of the Reconciliation Council was not present at that time.<ref name="CoD">''[[Cloak of Deception]]''</ref> Later, as the Council questioned [[Quinlan Vos/Legends|Quinlan Vos]] and his apparent turn to the dark side, Masters [[Saesee Tiin/Legends|Saesee Tiin]], [[Ki-Adi-Mundi/Legends|Ki-Adi-Mundi]] and [[Mace Windu/Legends|Mace Windu]] filled the three temporary positions and were present to pass judgment on the rogue Jedi.<ref name="SWR71" />

The Council of Reconciliation existed nearly continuously throughout the history of the Jedi Order, except for during the [[Great Galactic War]] when it was temporarily suspended due to the militarization of the Order at the time.<ref name="NoP">''[[Nexus of Power]]''</ref> The Council was disbanded at the end of the Clone Wars when the Republic was dissolved and reorganized into the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. With a [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Dark Lord of the Sith]] at the helm of the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]], the Council was caught unaware when [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] issued [[Order 66/Legends|Order 66]] and began the [[Great Jedi Purge/Legends|Great Jedi Purge]]. Following the [[Operation: Knightfall/Legends|fall]] of the Jedi Temple, the members of the Council were hunted down and killed or else fled into self-imposed exile.<ref name="ROTS" />
